stamped pass: Built redact-widget to the spec: scrub with three passes, a tool.call hook that rewrites Bash, PowerShell, Read and Grep results, the tally card in long and short wording, and 15 acceptance tests; the checker passes.

stamped send-back to build: Works live and matches the spec's card, but scrub has two faults: (1) a URL password with an empty user (redis://:secret@host) passes unscrubbed because the user part requires one character; (2) URL_PASSWORD is quadratic on long runs joined by '-', '.' or '+' (100,000 characters 2.5 s, 500,000 characters 63 s), which stalls the tool call. See inspection.md findings 1 and 2.

stamped pass: Fixed both findings in URL_PASSWORD: the user part may be empty so redis://:secret@host is scrubbed, and the scheme is bounded to 31 characters so scanning is linear (250,000 pairs of a- in about 13 ms); A5 gains the Redis, Celery and amqp samples and a timed scrub of 500,000 characters joined by -, . and +.
